secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key for AI features (network structuring, matching, intro drafting). Optional — app boots with fallback responses when absent. Obtain from Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com).

secrets.name: RAPIDAPI_KEY
secrets.description: RapidAPI key for the US Real Estate Listings API (https://rapidapi.com/apimaker/api/us-real-estate-listings). Must subscribe to the API's free tier (Basic = 100 req/month) after getting the key. Powers backend MLS data enrichment for AI recommendations.

secrets.name: LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: LinkedIn OAuth Client ID from the LinkedIn Developer Network (developer.linkedin.com → My Apps → your app → Credentials). Required to enable LinkedIn login and network connection syncing.

secrets.name: LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: LinkedIn OAuth Client Secret from the LinkedIn Developer Network (developer.linkedin.com → My Apps → your app → Credentials). Required together with LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID for the OAuth token exchange.
